_comment: Taiga voice notes. Buyers are physician-owners and practice administrators reading on their phone between patients. Lead with the cash-flow / denial-rate stat, never with technology.
shared_voice_notes: Lead with the operational stat (50% denial rate, 2% baseline vs 5-10% best-in-class) before naming any product.
Treat physicians as owner-operators, not 'targets'. Their problem is operational fragility, not 'lack of digital adoption'.
When citing data, name the specialty (psychiatry, dermatology, cardiology, etc.) so the reader sees themselves in it.
